headline: U.S. Could Reach Statutory Debt Limit by February, Think Tank Warns
summary: The Bipartisan Policy Center estimates that the United States government will soon exhaust its borrowing capacity and hit the federal debt limit by February.
why: Hitting the federal debt ceiling constrains the US Treasury's ability to issue debt, risking government shutdowns, rating downgrades, and volatility across Treasury debt markets.

impacts.name: US 10-year Treasury yield
impacts.why: Debt limit deadlines create uncertainty for Treasury bill issuance and liquidity conditions.
